description: Rename all gripper design versions in the repo and the live preview UI (catalog labels, picker, folder names or display names, whatever is cleanest without breaking history) to the Gripper N / Handle N / Base N scheme in AGENTS.md (mapping table there: 1.21 = Gripper 21, 2.6 = Handle 6, 3.3 = Base 3). Keep the mix-and-match pickers independent per part: Gripper, Handle, Base. Related: picker voice-bbe0e945, Base 3 (old 3.3) voice-3b311f32.
test_instructions: Open the live preview: no 1.x/2.x/3.x labels remain; pickers show Gripper N, Handle N and Base N and each selects independently.

results.identified_issue: Rename is display-only: publish_designs.py generations map id -> 'Kind N' and sets version kind_NN; gallery.js partVersion() parses ^(Gripper|Handle|Base) N$ names; KINDS maps handle->'handles' picker key (query param kept as handles=). finger_version() now matches ', Gripper N' in the VERSIONS.txt heading before the first ':' (comma required so a Gripper entry's own name doesn't count); v201/v202 report fingers 17 and v205 fingers 20, which dedupe against existing grippers. design_visibility.generation(design, kind) picks kind from a 'handle'/'base' word, default gripper. Folder rename deliberately skipped (ids = folder slugs; poses.js keyed by id; hidden.json stores ids). Old ?gripper=1.21 links no longer match and fall back to newest.
results.summary: Renamed every gripper design to Gripper N / Handle N / Base N in the catalog, live preview pickers, VERSIONS.txt and the hide/show voice command; folders and design ids left as-is so links and history keep working.
results.detailed_description: The live preview now names every Generalist design by part: Gripper 1–20 (plus 11b), Handle 1–6 and Base 1–3. The mix-and-match tile has three independent pickers, Gripper (1–21), Handle (No handle, 1–6) and Base (No base, 1–3). Its title reads like 'Gripper 21 + Handle 6 + Base 3', and links are now ?gripper=21&handles=6&base=3. Gripper 21 still comes from the fingers inside Handle 6 / Base 1–3. The publisher reads that from VERSIONS.txt headings, which now use the AGENTS.md form ('v303_generalist_inplane — Base 3 (voice-3b311f32), Gripper 21, Handle 6 reshaped:'). I rewrote every 1.x/2.x/3.x and Gen N reference in VERSIONS.txt, the gallery README and the code comments. Also, 'hide handle 3' / 'show base 1' now work by voice, with each part counted separately. Checked: unit tests pass (17), I republished the catalog, and a headless Chrome render of the live preview shows the three pickers with the new names (screenshot attached). Picking Gripper 18 + No handle + Base 1 also worked. What I did NOT do: rename the vNNN_* folders or design ids. Ids feed saved links, hidden.json and poses.js, so renaming them would break those. The new names live in one map in Scripts/publish_designs.py (generations), which is the one place to update when a new version is added. Heads-up: the 'Handle 6 reshaped' wording on Base 2/3 is mine, because those bases changed the handle shape rather than reusing Handle 6 as-is. Say if you'd prefer a new Handle number for them.
results.user_reply_draft: Hey Jake — done. summary: Gripper design versions in the repo and live preview UI use old numbering like 1.21, 2.6, and 3.3 instead of the AGENTS.md scheme. Rename them to Gripper N, Handle N, and Base N across catalog labels and pickers without breaking history, keeping each part's mix-and-match picker independent.
